definition: to feel that you may vomit or be ill
translation: thấy buồn nôn, thấy không khỏe
exampleSentence: I feel sick after the boat ride.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thấy buồn nôn sau chuyến đi thuyền.

definition: to feel that you need rest or sleep
exampleSentence: I always feel tired on Monday morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng thứ Hai tôi lúc nào cũng thấy mệt.

definition: to be less ill or less sad than before
exampleSentence: I feel better after a good sleep.
exampleTranslation: Ngủ một giấc xong tôi thấy khá hơn.

definition: to have a body temperature that is higher than normal
exampleSentence: The child has a fever and a cough.
exampleTranslation: Đứa trẻ bị sốt và ho.

definition: to have a painful throat
exampleSentence: I have a sore throat, so I can't sing.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị đau họng nên không hát được.

definition: to cough often because of illness
exampleSentence: She has had a cough for a week.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy bị ho cả tuần nay.

definition: to feel pain in your stomach
exampleSentence: He has a stomachache after lunch.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy bị đau bụng sau bữa trưa.

definition: to feel pain in a tooth
exampleSentence: I have a toothache and need to see a dentist.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị đau răng và cần đi khám nha sĩ.

definition: to have liquid coming out of your nose because of a cold
exampleSentence: I have a runny nose and I keep sneezing.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị sổ mũi và cứ hắt hơi liên tục.

definition: to go to a doctor for advice or treatment
exampleSentence: You should see a doctor about that cough.
exampleTranslation: Bạn nên đi khám bác sĩ về cơn ho đó.

definition: to arrange a time to see a doctor or other professional
exampleSentence: I'd like to book an appointment for Tuesday.
exampleTranslation: Tôi muốn đặt lịch hẹn vào thứ Ba.

definition: to swallow a small piece of medicine
exampleSentence: Take a pill every eight hours.
exampleTranslation: Cứ tám tiếng uống một viên thuốc.

definition: to measure how hot your body is
exampleSentence: The nurse took my temperature.
exampleTranslation: Y tá đo nhiệt độ cho tôi.

definition: to be given a vaccine that protects you from a disease
exampleSentence: All children should be vaccinated against measles.
exampleTranslation: Mọi trẻ em nên được tiêm phòng bệnh sởi.

definition: to relax or sleep so that you feel better
exampleSentence: You need to get some rest.
exampleTranslation: Bạn cần nghỉ ngơi một chút.

definition: a night when you sleep well
translation: một giấc ngủ ngon suốt đêm
exampleSentence: I feel better after a good night's sleep.
exampleTranslation: Ngủ ngon suốt đêm xong, tôi thấy khá hơn.

definition: to drink a lot of water
exampleSentence: Drink plenty of water in hot weather.
exampleTranslation: Hãy uống nhiều nước khi trời nóng.

definition: to eat different kinds of food in the right amounts
exampleSentence: Doctors say we should eat a balanced diet.
exampleTranslation: Bác sĩ khuyên chúng ta nên ăn uống cân bằng.

definition: to not become ill
exampleSentence: Walking every day helps me stay healthy.
exampleTranslation: Đi bộ mỗi ngày giúp tôi giữ gìn sức khỏe.

definition: to keep your body strong and fit
exampleSentence: He swims to stay in shape.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy bơi để giữ thể lực.

definition: to do exercise so that your body stays strong
exampleSentence: She goes running to keep fit.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy chạy bộ để giữ thể lực.

definition: to become heavier
exampleSentence: I gained weight during the holidays.
exampleTranslation: Tôi tăng cân trong kỳ nghỉ.

definition: to become heavier
exampleSentence: He has put on weight since he stopped running.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy tăng cân từ khi ngừng chạy bộ.

definition: to do physical exercise often
exampleSentence: People who exercise regularly sleep better.
exampleTranslation: Những người tập thể dục đều đặn ngủ ngon hơn.

definition: to run for exercise or pleasure
exampleSentence: I go for a run before breakfast.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đi chạy bộ trước bữa sáng.

definition: to walk for exercise or pleasure
exampleSentence: Let's go for a walk after dinner.
exampleTranslation: Sau bữa tối mình đi dạo nhé.

definition: to visit a place with exercise equipment
exampleSentence: She goes to the gym three times a week.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy đi tập gym ba lần một tuần.

definition: to practice yoga exercises
exampleSentence: I do yoga every morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nào tôi cũng tập yoga.

definition: to take part in games and physical activities
exampleSentence: My children play sports after school.
exampleTranslation: Các con tôi chơi thể thao sau giờ học.

definition: to damage a bone in your arm
exampleSentence: He fell off his bike and broke his arm.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy ngã xe đạp và bị gãy tay.

definition: to hurt your ankle by twisting it
exampleSentence: She sprained her ankle playing football.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy bị bong gân cổ chân khi chơi bóng đá.

definition: to hurt your finger with something sharp
exampleSentence: I cut my finger while chopping onions.
exampleTranslation: Tôi bị đứt tay khi thái hành.

definition: to hurt your hand with something hot
exampleSentence: Be careful, or you'll burn your hand.
exampleTranslation: Cẩn thận kẻo bị bỏng tay đấy.

definition: to experience pain in your body
exampleSentence: He felt pain in his back.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy thấy đau ở lưng.

definition: to make pain less strong
exampleSentence: This medicine can relieve pain quickly.
exampleTranslation: Loại thuốc này có thể giảm đau nhanh.

definition: a condition in which the pressure of the blood in the body is too high
exampleSentence: My father has high blood pressure.
exampleTranslation: Bố tôi bị huyết áp cao.

definition: a body temperature that is much higher than normal
exampleSentence: The baby has a high fever.
exampleTranslation: Em bé bị sốt cao.

definition: a mild illness that makes your nose run and your throat sore
exampleSentence: The common cold usually goes away in a week.
exampleTranslation: Cảm lạnh thông thường thường khỏi sau một tuần.

definition: a disease that is dangerous or hard to treat
exampleSentence: She is recovering from a serious illness.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy đang hồi phục sau một trận bệnh nặng.

definition: to become completely healthy again
exampleSentence: He made a full recovery after the operation.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy hồi phục hoàn toàn sau ca mổ.

definition: the state of your mind and emotions
exampleSentence: Sleep is important for mental health.
exampleTranslation: Giấc ngủ rất quan trọng đối với sức khỏe tinh thần.

definition: exercise and movement that is good for your body
exampleSentence: Children need an hour of physical activity every day.
exampleTranslation: Trẻ em cần một giờ hoạt động thể chất mỗi ngày.

definition: an unwanted effect of a medicine
exampleSentence: The pills may have side effects.
exampleTranslation: Thuốc này có thể gây tác dụng phụ.

definition: an agreement to pay for your medical costs
exampleSentence: Do you have health insurance?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có bảo hiểm y tế không?

definition: basic help given to a sick or injured person before a doctor arrives
exampleSentence: He learned first aid at work.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy học sơ cứu ở chỗ làm.

definition: to write what medicine a patient should take
exampleSentence: The doctor wrote a prescription for antibiotics.
exampleTranslation: Bác sĩ kê đơn thuốc kháng sinh.

definition: to get the medicine that a doctor has ordered
exampleSentence: I need to fill a prescription at the pharmacy.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần lấy thuốc theo đơn ở hiệu thuốc.

definition: to use glasses to help you see
exampleSentence: He has to wear glasses to read.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy phải đeo kính khi đọc.

definition: to have an operation on your body
exampleSentence: She had surgery on her knee last year.
exampleTranslation: Năm ngoái cô ấy phẫu thuật đầu gối.

definition: to be affected by stress
exampleSentence: Many students suffer from stress during exams.
exampleTranslation: Nhiều học sinh bị căng thẳng trong mùa thi.
